summary: Genshin Impact entries from the prepared 1000-title candidate queue, researched for Sami's fidelity-first archive route.

entries.title: Genshin Impact

emulation.notes: Use the current native or official release route where available.

primary.why: The Windows release has scalable settings and clean capture, while PlayStation and Xbox provide the other major platform routes. PC is the best fidelity-first primary unless a console-only account constraint applies.
primary.how_to_play: Play the current Windows build through HoYoverse/Epic/official PC distribution, install the latest assets, and record the game version because regions, quests, events, and platform support change over time.

entries.remaster_caveats: Live-service events rotate, and PlayStation 4 support/content updates ended after April 8, 2026 per PlayStation's page; record the game version/date for archive captures.
